scientific_integrity: The published source is credited for the B-infinity weighted semantics, its embedding of Kripke models, the state/weight complexity measures, and the small-model theorem. The retained contribution is the exact two-parameter state--weight frontier for one explicit exact-count formula family. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a specific finite-model witness family in graded modal logic. It does not sharpen the general small-model bound for arbitrary formulas and does not require the infinity-diamond connective itself.
title: Exact state--weight Pareto frontier for a graded-modal counting witness
